name: WMUISegmentProgress
description: Multi-segment progress bar where every segment keeps its own rounded caps. Stacked views cannot produce per-segment caps, so the bar is drawn as vectors and renders identically on iOS, Android and web.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: Segments to render. Each row may carry a value, a color and a label. Example: [{label: 'Used', value: 40, color: '#2563EB'}]

valueField.name: valueField
valueField.description: Row field holding each segment's numeric value. Default: value

colorField.name: colorField
colorField.description: Row field holding a per-segment color. Rows without one fall back to the palette. Default: color

total.name: total
total.description: Denominator for the bar. 0 sums the segments so the bar always fills; set a fixed total to show remaining capacity. Default: 0

gap.name: gap
gap.description: Separator width in pixels between adjacent segments. Default: 2

cornerRadius.name: cornerRadius
cornerRadius.description: Corner radius applied to each segment's caps. Default: 6

trackColor.name: trackColor
trackColor.description: Color of the unfilled track behind the segments. Default: #E5E7EB

colors.name: colors
colors.description: Palette cycled through for rows that carry no color. Example: ['#2563EB', '#10B981', '#F59E0B']

onSegmentSelect.name: onSegmentSelect
onSegmentSelect.description: Fires with the segment that was tapped, along with its value and share of the bar.
